measurement: Read-only aggregate counts immediately before unchanged helper-return fact extraction, in each normal rule worker. No values, keys, target execution, paid calls or result rewriting. AST equivalence verifies the original body is unchanged apart from the counter call.
diagnostic_proceed_condition: At least100000 observed empty-fact binding visits, representing at least80% of observed binding visits across workers. Partial snapshots are disclosed and cannot establish timing or a completed scan. This is a conservative interpretation of substantial repeated empty-fact work, not the native gain retention criterion. If unmet, stop without an optimization.
native_retention_unchanged: At least5% lower median wall AND worker-inclusive CPU on each named input; neither candidate observation above corresponding baseline max; all complete and ordered reports identical; otherwise revert.
